bull_bear.body:
- Net Debt/EBITDA (external) stood at 1.3x in Q2 and H1 FY27; stated priorities are prudent liquidity management, disciplined capital allocation, robust financial controls and governance/compliance adherence as an independent listed entity.
- Net debt was reset sharply lower through demerger adjustments (from ₹12,296 Cr pre-adjustment to ₹2,508 Cr post-demerger at the Mar'26 base), after which it moved to ₹2,763 Cr by Sept'26 on cash from operations offset by working-capital and growth-capex outflows.
- Management (CFO) stated continued focus on working capital management and cash generation to fund strategic growth investments while maintaining balance sheet discipline.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Integrated mining and steel business model linking resource access, mining operations and steel production, giving a platform to manage operational interdependencies and respond to industry cycles.
- Became an independent listed company following the Vedanta group demerger effective 1 May 2026; CRISIL assigned an AA/Stable credit rating during Q2/H1 FY27 as an independent assessment of its financial profile.
- India's infrastructure development, manufacturing expansion and growing steel demand are framed as a long-term sector opportunity that the integrated model and operating capabilities position VISL to participate in.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Demerger] The company's H1FY27 financials and debt/finance-cost trends are materially shaped by the Vedanta group demerger effective 1 May 2026; prior-period figures and some YoY comparisons (finance cost, interest income, inter-company debt) are not on a like-for-like basis.
- [Segment anomaly] Iron Ore Karnataka (IOK) segment sales/production were disrupted in Q2 due to a post-demerger entity name-change transfer, with dispatches only resuming in September 2026.
business.title: Notable from the deck
